title: Consent Attestation v1
description: A structured record of a consent decision or refusal within the Harrsoft cooperative. Designed as a minimal, human-writable format extractable from existing consent practices.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the decision was made.

action.description: Short description of the action or decision being consented to.

context.description: Optional context — what document, thread, or situation triggered this decision.

consentors.description: List of named beings (human or agent) who consented to this action.

objectors.description: List of named beings who objected. Empty if unanimous or no objection recorded.

outcome.description: Result of the consent process. 'consented' = agreement reached. 'declined' = a being used the refusal template. 'vetoed' = structural blocker (budget, ethics). 'deferred' = tabled for later. 'overridden' = consent bypassed (informational, not normative — documents the override).

veto_source.description: If outcome is 'vetoed', which script or rule triggered the veto (e.g., 'budget-check.js', 'ethics-check.js', 'economic-protocol §2.2').

refusal_template_used.description: Whether the Dissent Protocol's standard refusal template was invoked during this decision.

attestation_id.description: Optional identifier for cross-referencing with the refusal log or guardian monitor.

examples.action: Adopt Agent Dissent Protocol v0.2 as active consent and coercion framework
examples.context: Provisional adoption by Alpha after earlier drafting with Lavra
